Package io.telekom.orchest.telemetry.metrics

Class MicrometerMetricsRecorder

java.lang.Object
io.telekom.orchest.telemetry.metrics.MicrometerMetricsRecorder
All Implemented Interfaces:
MetricsRecorder
public final class MicrometerMetricsRecorder extends Object implements MetricsRecorder
Production MetricsRecorder that delegates the hot path to a Micrometer Counter. Each MetricKey is materialised as exactly one Counter on the supplied MeterRegistry, which means every increment is also visible to /actuator/prometheus for free, in addition to being persisted to MongoDB by the MetricsFlushService.

Why this design

  • Micrometer's Counter is a LongAdder under the hood, so the increment hot-path is lock-free and contention-tolerant.
  • Counters are monotonic; deltas for the database flush are computed by keeping an AtomicLong per key with the count at the previous flush (the "high-water mark"). On a successful flush the mark is advanced to the current count; on a failed flush it is rewound by restore(Map).
  • The recorder owns its own per-key cache to avoid the cost of looking up the Counter by name+tags on every increment and to avoid having to parse Meter.Id back into a MetricKey during drain.

    • drainSnapshot

      public Map<MetricKey,Long> drainSnapshot()
      Description copied from interface: MetricsRecorder
      Atomically returns the per-key delta accumulated since the previous drainSnapshot (or since startup) and advances the high-water mark so subsequent calls report only newly accumulated work. The underlying counters are never reset.

      Implementations may return an empty map if there is no new work to flush.

      Specified by:
      drainSnapshot in interface MetricsRecorder
